nodes.label: Slider Arrow SVG Icon
nodes.description: A downward-pointing chevron/arrow SVG icon used as a navigation arrow for the card-slider content block. The icon is a simple V-shape (chevron down) drawn with a white stroke (#fff), no fill, with rounded line caps and joins. Viewbox is 32.174x14.285, making it wider than tall. Used as a UI control indicator for carousel/slider navigation.
